title: AI Agent Development
problem: Your team has tasks that need judgement, several steps and access to tools — and a single chatbot prompt can't handle them.
outcome: Agents that can take a task, work through it using your tools, and return a finished result your team can review.

title: AI Automation
problem: Repetitive work still needs a human because it involves reading, classifying or summarising information.
outcome: Workflows where AI handles the reading and routing, and people only step in for decisions that matter.

title: Browser Automation
problem: Information lives in websites and portals with no API — someone has to click through them every day.
outcome: Browser tasks that run on a schedule, capture what happened, and hand structured results to the rest of your system.

title: Workflow Automation
problem: Data is copied between forms, sheets, CRMs and chat tools by hand, and nobody knows when something breaks.
build: Run logs visible to the team
outcome: A connected workflow with clear inputs, clear outputs and visibility into every run.

title: Web Scraping & Data Processing
problem: You need structured data from many pages or sources, cleaned and ready to use.
outcome: Clean, structured datasets produced on demand or on schedule — instead of manual copy-paste.

title: LLM-Powered Applications

build: Chat & analysis features with structured outputs
outcome: AI features that are part of a real product, not a demo — with predictable behaviour and costs.

title: Custom Internal Tools
problem: Your team runs on spreadsheets and manual checks because the tool you need doesn't exist.
outcome: A focused internal tool that removes the spreadsheet and makes the process visible.

title: Full-Stack Web Applications

outcome: A maintainable product built end to end, ready to grow AI and automation features later.
